activity_context.topic_title: The Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation

feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $v$ given below. 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 8\end{aligned}]
$$

If $\,T\,$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $\,T,$ find $\,T(v).$

| $T(v)=\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,T(v)=T\cdot v\,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-18 \\ -16\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
